Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Alok Dalakoti, learned counsel for the
petitioner(s) appeared through V.C.
2. Mr. Devesh Ghildiyal, learned Brief Holder for
the State/contemnor.
3. On instructions, learned counsel for the
respondent-contemnors submits that order of the
Writ Court dated 17.12.2024 has been complied with
by deciding the representation submitted by the
petitioner. The representation has been rejected by
the respondent-contemnor and, according to him,
these contempt petitions have rendered infructuous.

UKHC010008442026
2026:UHC:7421
He supplied the order dated 30.10.2025/06.06.2026
passed in all the writ petitions, which is taken on
record, a copy of which has also been served upon
the petitioner(s) in all these contempt petitions.
4. Learned counsel for the respondent/contemnor
submits that in all cases, similar orders have been
passed, though by different authorities, but the crux
of the matter is that the order passed by the Writ
Court has been complied with.
5. In such view of the matter, all contempt
petitions are hereby closed. Petitioner(s) is at liberty
to challenge the order passed by the respondent-contemnor, by which the representation was
rejected, by filing fresh writ petition(s).
(Pankaj Purohit, J.)
